# precedence scope

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:precedenceScope`](gmeow-precedenceScope.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/precedenceScope>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)

The normative system within which this precedence holds. Functional and mandatory (SHACL): precedence is always scoped — a system orders its own norms; it cannot order the world's.
